none: PAS SF-C76146: Late early medieval nummular brooch
contea di ritrovamento: Suffolk (Inghilterra e Galles)

A lead nummular brooch of late early medieval, 9th-10th century in date, now incomplete as a fragment of one side is missing due to an old break. Nummular brooches are so called as they are ultimately derived from coins and often have rings of pellets, around a central 'coin' motif.
